svg.title: Blue Green Red
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Primary Peter Freeman 2005 PF0900 caption explicitly gives EK303,12×16inches. Small red-ground painting with two rounded vertical green/blue bars; distinct from the large Met 1963 work. Brush texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.peterfreemaninc.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly/selected-works?view=multiple-sliders; record freeman:PF0900; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
